body:
Real investigation: no shared UI framework exists anywhere in this monorepo, every game reinvents bespoke immediate-mode drawing code. PARENA's own widget.prn is real but narrow (one Toggle widget, no cascade/box-model). Real research into litehtml shows a from-scratch HTML/CSS engine is a genuinely disproportionate undertaking vs the actual stated need. Real fork named: full engine (not recommended) vs vendoring webview/webview for embedded (matching MJOLNIR's real Android WebView precedent) vs a lightweight PARENA-native declarative styling layer (recommended v0). Scoping doc: docs/EOSUI_NORTHSTAR.md, golden-indexed as EOSUI-NORTH.

⚓ ☃
title: EOSUI-1244/EOSUI-12444: cross-game UI design language scoped (Principle 19), not built
